utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s the repair drive for, and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up the helpers and tools for the repair drive, and I’ll let everyone know what’s next once the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just send me the time and what I should bring when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping everything organized. What would you like to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I can help with whatever’s most useful first, and I’ll plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Faye — thank you. Let’s start with setting up the tool table and checking in volunteers when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can lend you a drill and a hammer for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I could use the hammer, and maybe you can remind me what time we’re meeting? I’m a bit foggy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word to both friend groups and help keep everyone in the loop. Once the time’s set, I’ll also point people toward the tools and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Jules. I’ll bring the cordless drill, tape measure, spare screws, and I’ll try to find my work gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Noah — thank you! I’ll let everyone know you’re bringing those tools, and I’ll keep an ear out for when the time gets set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — that should help a lot. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Saturday at 10 a.m. by the community shed — got it. I’ll spread the word to the neighbors right away!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll start inviting everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and what do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Dane — I’m starting with the tool list and who can bring what for the repair drive. If you can help spread the word, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and keep an eye out for anyone who can bring tools. Let me know if there’s anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Nell — the repair drive is still on this weekend, and folks are bringing in tools, bikes, and small appliances. If you’ve got something needing a fix, I’d swing by early so you catch the good volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still catching updates second-hand, so I appreciate it. I’ll try to come early and see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the spirit, Nell — early birds usually get the best fixers. If you hear of anything you want worked on, bring it along and I’ll keep an ear out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already set a date for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet — I’m still checking with folks, but I’ll let you know as soon as we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, please keep me posted—once you set it, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — I’d appreciate the update when you have it. A clear schedule would help me plan my week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help with the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard the latest details yet—just let me know the schedule when you have it, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll look for any extra screws, duct tape, glue, and spare tools I have and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep the repair drive list updated. Anything extra you find will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check tonight and bring anything useful I find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping an eye out for the repair drive location and time. If you’ve got them, send them my way and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still sure it’s happening, right? I’ll check the time and drop-off spot and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep an eye out too, and just send me the time and drop-off spot when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still checking with folks before we pick a date for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll let the others know we’re still checking and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep checking with folks and let you know as soon as we can set a date for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive for, and when do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — the repair drive is just to help fix up a few things around the neighborhood. Tell me what you can do, and I’ll point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do light cleanup or basic fixes. Point me where you need me this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: We’re still on for the repair drive, right? I just want to confirm the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, we’re still on — Saturday at 9. I’ll bring the cordless drill, tape measure, spare screws, and I’ll try to find my work gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — can you confirm the drop-off spot too? I just want to make sure I’ve got everything right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’m still planning on Saturday around 10 at the side entrance. If the time or drop-off spot changes, please let me know ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for any changes and let you know right away. Saturday around 10 at the side entrance is noted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I appreciate it — that plan works for me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can lend you a drill and a hammer for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — I’m just checking on the latest update for the repair drive and keeping people posted while I’m out. I’ll pass along that you can lend a drill and hammer.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering screws, duct tape, glue, and any spare tools folks can lend. If you’ve got anything extra, I can add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll add screws, duct tape, glue, and spare tools to the list and keep everyone posted about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep the list updated and let folks know we still need any extra supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, and I’ll share it as soon as I get it. In the meantime, bring any tools or parts your item might need so you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for the exact time and place, and I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — if you hear the repair drive location and time, please let me know. I’m still catching up, so I appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the location and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. I’m counting on your update so I can catch up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive and keeping the friend groups in the loop. If you can help sort donated tools or check off the repair list, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules. Please keep me posted on the schedule and the repair list, and I can help sort the donated tools when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted as soon as the schedule is set, and I’ll send over the repair list when it’s ready. Thanks again for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s still on for this weekend—tools, bikes, and small appliances are all welcome. If you’ve got something needing a fix, I’d swing by early so you can catch the good volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes. I’ll try to be there early with my bike.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — that’ll help a ton. I’ll keep telling folks to come early with their stuff so they can catch the best volunteer fixers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 works for me—please send the location when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Saturday at 9 sounds good — I’ll send the location as soon as I’ve got it. Thanks for helping work around the school schedule!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — happy to help, and I’ll keep that morning open. Just send the location when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — if you can bring the toolkit and a few extension cords, that would really help. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you already set a date and drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it starts at 10 a.m. at the community center, near the front entrance. Thanks, Mina — see you there!
